title: 第九章 断尾第十章 塌了
content_zh:
这么一说的话，看看毫无异样的来路，好像是有点不正常，但吴斤两还是找到了理由，“矿洞里的宝物应该比我们重要吧，对他们来说，先顾着宝物也没什么不正常吧？”
师春正儿八经告诉他，“那紫闪闪的星云在我身上。”
“啊？”吴斤两大吃一惊，没想到他这么大胆，居然敢在众人的眼皮子底下把那宝物给弄走，真是绝了，当即就伸手去撩他的裤裆，“哪呢，哪呢，拿出来看看…”
啪！师春一把拍开他的手，“回头再说。”
缩回手的吴斤两讪笑，看了看天色，倒是脑补了原因，“也是，天都黑了，这发光东西一亮出来，很容易暴露。”转而又神情凝重，“是啊，你把人苦心费力的宝物给抢了，居然连个抢回去的意思都没有，何况人家实力还上还占了上风，确实有点不正常。”
何止是有点，而是非常不正常，一脸警惕的师春再次环顾四周，认定了这事绝没那么简单，阴暗暗的四周似暗藏恐怖，越是不明所以，心神越发紧绷了起来。
摆明了打打杀杀的，他倒不怕，未知没底的事情反而让他感到紧张，明枪易躲暗箭难防是至理。
这精神刚紧张到一个度，他突然“嗯”一声闷哼，手上刀都顾不上了，两手骤然抱了脑袋，之前那种脑袋要撕裂成千万瓣，无数虫蚁啃咬脊髓的痛感又出来了。
这次不知是因为经历了一次较为适应了，还是烈度较轻了，倒没有痛到上次欲要昏死过去的程度，但也足够他受的。
没变的是，眼前又出现了那奇奇怪怪让人不明所以的画面，似乎又置身在了一个光影虚幻的世界里。
这个世界很奇怪，好像不受任何光线的影响，矿洞内的灯光和此时的天地光景对其光暗程度没有任何改变。
闭右眼看到的是正常天地，闭左眼看到的则是光怪离奇的画面，他搞不明白这因痛疼导致的视力幻觉是怎么回事。
如此明显的异常，吴斤两不可能发现不了，吃了一惊，伸手把住了他，“春天，怎么了？”
谁知痛得直哆嗦的师春却一把拨开了他，翻身躺在了斜坡上喘息，只见紧咬着牙关，十指紧抠在掌内，下了很大决心似的，硬生生坐了起来，闭上了左眼，颤抖着扭头扫视四周。
扔下了武器的吴斤两跪地扶了扶他，就要给他把脉检查，“春天，你别吓我，到底怎么了？”
师春一个肘击撞在了他的胸口，从哆嗦的牙缝里强行蹦出几个字来，“闭嘴，躺下，别挡着。”
被撞翻的吴斤两本要顺势爬起，闻听此言，刚翘首欲起的他又顺势躺下了，两眼忽闪地盯着，很想问问，闭着一只眼到处乱瞅是什么意思。
师春也只是忽然想起了之前在矿洞内中招后逃离时，在拐角处看到一群人的情形。
对四周不安的强烈预感，碰撞上了脑海里闪现的矿洞画面，让他强撑了起来，闭上了左眼，用右眼试试。
呼吸依然紊乱，右眼视线慢慢扫过那光怪离奇的画面，慢慢转动的脑袋忽然定住。

他只是试试，谁知真看到虚空中浮着两个白蒙蒙的雾状体，两个雾状体并不在一块，一个在向另一个慢慢靠近。
注意力一转移，人感觉都没那么难受了。
他闭上了右眼开左眼，白蒙蒙雾状体消失了，对应所在位置，并非浮在虚空，其中一个所在的位置就在他们要前往方向的那座山头上。
再闭左眼开右眼，两个画面对比，确实就在那个位置，另一个白蒙蒙雾状体已经与之靠在了一起。
这番动静变化对比早先在山洞内看到的群像，令他意识到了，真的有可能看到了两个暗伏的人，为什么会这样？他也不明白是怎么回事。
那边山头上也确实暗伏了两个人，两个黑布巾蒙面的人，他们也盯上了师春二人。
得亏这里寸草不生到处光溜溜的，有人晃动在视线内容易察觉到，真要是山林中的话，就算修士的眼力异于常人也难发现。不过天色毕竟暗了，距离又略远，不从近前过的话，他们也看不太清楚是什么样的两人。
从对面暗伏点后爬到山头的蒙面人，低声问原地的蒙面人，“什么情况，这两人怎么坐那歇上了？”
原地的悄声回：“我怎么知道。”
后来的：“那这算是离开此地的，还是不算？”
原地的：“难不成你觉得他们是跑来玩的，还会折返不成？”
后来的轻轻嘿笑了声，显然也意识到了此问有点多余。
原地的解下了腰间一个拳头大的编织笼子，打开了盖子，抓出了一只小鸟，只见小鸟身上隐约涂写有“四七”字样，然后往后方山谷里一扔。
那小鸟立刻顺势穿过山谷飞了去。
师春右眼看到了那只飞走的小鸟，只不过是一小团白蒙蒙雾状体，但是能从形态动静上隐约感觉出是什么，大概也能猜到这个时候放飞的小鸟有什么作用。
他目光闪烁着，已然忘了疼痛，再次打量周围，想看看还有没有其他人形的白蒙蒙雾状体。
隐约看到有，但所处位置似乎较远，换左眼视线对比，确实较远，隔了几个山头，看方位，与这里应该是同一阵线排布的，换右眼想再看远一些，也不知这视力到底能看多远的距离，反正没有再看到其他雾状体。
content_en:
To put it this way, it seemed a bit abnormal to see that there was no difference in the origin, but Wu Jinliang still found a reason, "The treasures in the mine should be more important than us. For them, there is nothing abnormal about taking care of the treasures first, right?"
Shi Chun Zheng'er Ba Jing told him, "The purple shining nebula is on my body."
"Ah?" Wu Jinliang was shocked. He didn't expect him to be so bold. He actually dared to take the treasure away under everyone's eyes. It was really amazing. He immediately reached out to lift his crotch, "Where is it? Where is it? Take it out and take a look..."
Snap! Shi Chun slapped his hand away and said, "We'll talk about it later."
Wu Jinliang, who withdrew his hand, smiled sarcastically, looked at the sky, and figured out the reason, "Yes, it's already dark, and this luminous thing will be easily exposed when it lights up." Then he looked solemn, "Yes, you robbed a treasure that someone worked so hard for, and you didn't even have the intention to take it back. What's more, you still have the upper hand because of your strength. It's really a bit abnormal."
Not just a little bit, but very abnormal. Shi Chun looked around again with a vigilant face and decided that this matter was definitely not that simple. The dark surroundings seemed to be hiding terror. The more he didn't understand the reason, the more nervous he became.
He was not afraid of those who would fight and kill him, but the unknown and uncertain things made him nervous.
Just when his nerves reached a certain level, he suddenly grunted, not caring about the knife in his hand, and suddenly hugged his head with both hands. The pain from before that his head was about to be torn into millions of pieces, and that countless insects and ants were gnawing at his spinal cord came back.
This time, I don't know whether it was because he was more accustomed to it after experiencing it once, or because the intensity was lighter. It wasn't so painful that he almost fainted last time, but it was enough for him to bear.
What didn't change was that the strange and confusing picture appeared in front of him again, and he seemed to be in a world of illusory light and shadow again.
This world is very strange, as if it is not affected by any light. The lights in the mine and the scenery of the world at this time have no change in the light and darkness.
When he closed his right eye, he saw the normal world, but when he closed his left eye, he saw a strange and bizarre scene. He couldn't figure out what the visual hallucination caused by the pain was.
It was impossible for Wu Jinliang not to notice such an obvious abnormality. He was startled and reached out to hold him, "Spring, what's wrong?"
Unexpectedly, Shi Chun, who was shivering in pain, pushed him away, turned over and lay on the slope, panting. He clenched his teeth and dug his fingers tightly into his palms. As if he had made a lot of determination, he sat up abruptly, closed his left eye, and turned his head to look around tremblingly.
Wu Jinliang dropped his weapon and knelt down to help him, and was about to check his pulse, "Spring, don't scare me, what's wrong?"
Shi Chun hit him in the chest with an elbow, and forced out a few words through his trembling teeth, "Shut up, lie down, don't block it."
Wu Jinliang, who was knocked over, was about to get up. After hearing this, he lay down again just as he was about to get up. His eyes flickered and he wanted to ask what it meant to look around with one eye closed.
Shi Chun just suddenly remembered how he saw a group of people at the corner when he was fleeing after being attacked in the mine.
The strong premonition of the unrest around him collided with the image of the mine that flashed in his mind, causing him to push himself up, close his left eye, and try with his right eye.
His breathing was still disordered, his right eye slowly scanned the bizarre scene, and his slowly turning head suddenly froze.
He was just trying, but he actually saw two white mist-like bodies floating in the void. The two mist-like bodies were not together, and one was slowly approaching the other.
Once the attention is shifted, people feel less uncomfortable.
He closed his right eye and opened his left eye. The white mist-like objects disappeared. The corresponding locations were not floating in the void. One of them was located in the direction they were going.On the top of the mountain.
Close your left eye and open your right eye again. Comparing the two images, you can see that there is indeed another white mist-like object at that position, already close to it.
Comparing this change of movement with the group of portraits he saw in the cave earlier, he realized that he might really have seen two people hiding in secret. Why was this happening? He didn't understand what was going on.
There were indeed two people hiding on the top of the mountain over there, two men masked with black cloth scarves, and they were also eyeing Shi Chun.
Fortunately, there is no grass here and everything is bare, so it is easy to detect someone moving in the line of sight. If it were really in the mountains and forests, even a monk with extraordinary eyesight would be hard-pressed to spot it. But after all, the sky was dark and the distance was a little far away. If they didn't get closer, they wouldn't be able to see clearly what kind of two they were.
The masked man who climbed to the top of the hill from ambush on the opposite side asked the masked man on the spot in a low voice, "What's going on? Why are these two people sitting there to rest?"
He whispered back: "How do I know?"
Later: "Does this count as leaving this place, or does it not count?"
On the spot: "Do you think they came here to play and will they turn back?"
Then he chuckled slightly, obviously realizing that this question was a bit redundant.
On the spot, he untied a fist-sized woven cage from his waist, opened the lid, and took out a little bird. The word "Four Seven" was vaguely scrawled on the bird's body, and then he threw it into the valley behind.
The little bird immediately flew across the valley.
Shi Chun saw the bird flying away with his right eye. It was just a small ball of white mist, but he could vaguely feel what it was from the shape and movement, and he could probably guess the role of the bird released at this time.
His eyes flickered, forgetting the pain, and looked around again to see if there were any other human-shaped white mist-like bodies.
I could vaguely see it, but it seemed to be far away. When I compared the sight with my left eye, it was indeed far away. It was a few hills away. Judging from the direction, it should be on the same front line as here. I tried to see farther with my right eye, but I didn't know how far this vision could see. Anyway, I didn't see any other mist-like objects.
